cache-stampede:cache:.title: A hot item's expiry would flood Catalog database.
cache-stampede:cache:.message: Other requests's most popular item gets 200/s. Each time it expires, about 28 requests reach Catalog database before the first reply. Cold cache probe: hard purge at 5 s, replay to 20 s at configured rates.
cache-stampede:cache:.rationale: Cache benefits depend on item reuse. Cold-cache probes use configured traffic, not saved story peaks; replay budgets can leave caches unchecked.
